notes.title: Exclusive Vector 2 Closed Beta Test on iOS open for sign-up!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

As you may know we are currently developing a sequel to our parkours hit Vector. 
We are happy to announce that the first stage of the Closed Beta Test is open for enlistment.
To sign up for Closed Beta Test you must have an iOS 8 or higher device and fill the [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/19kydOZoNEyEU0QJVD5k1TC2g7fiacbW0Rtc9uNBzE9c/viewform] following form[/url].

The number of participants is limited - run for it!

notes.title: Time To Run! New Tracks Available
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce a major update of Vector. Now our game contains all tracks we have planned for it. There are 50+ achievements to get, 60 tricks to perform, 100+ tracks to beat and 350+ stars to earn. Don't waste your time!

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Downtown Bonus 1-9 Track for both game modes[/b]. You have never experienced such challenge before!
[*][b]9 Technopark Bonus Tracks for both game modes[/b]. Now you have a complete list of tracks for Vector.
[*][b]Support of Steam Cloud[/b]. Now you can sync your progress among different PC's.
[*][b]No more crashes[/b]. Thank to your feedback our team implemented all possible bug fixes.
[*][b]New achievements[/b]. For true perfectionists.
[/list]

notes.title: Be The Hunter! FREE DLC, Fixes & More
notes.notes:
[b]The most anticipated update is finally here![/b] Enjoy the whole story from a different angle. Take the role of the Hunter and catch the Runner before he escapes. All tracks were rebalanced exclusively for Hunter Mode to bring you a true hardcore skill-based experience. 

[b]Take the challenge![/b] To oppose an outstanding runner you must become a superior chaser. To get all three stars in Hunter Mode you need not only to run through the track but to collect all bonuses and perform all tricks before catching our infamous escapee.

[b]You want more? No problem![/b] In the upcoming weeks we plan to add [i]Technopark Bonus Tracks[/i] for both game modes.

Oh, we also implemented some bug fixes. Those who had game crashes during the intro should be able to play now. 

Please, check out the updated version of Vector. Do not hesitate to describe your technical issues in an [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/248970/discussions/0/522728814390846261/] appropriate thread [/url], if you still have experience them. Your feedback is important for us!

notes.title: Letters Of Intent: Metamorphabet
notes.notes:
The work of some developers is as immediately recognisable as a particular painter’s oeuvre*. Take Metamorphabet, a game in which the alphabet comes to life one letter at a time. The player strokes, pokes and tickles each grapheme, causing appendages to sprout and activities to commence. The trailer shows an ‘A’ undergoing changes related to ‘antlers’, ‘arch’ and ‘amble’. The graphical style and friendly digital toy nature of the trailer immediately reminded me of Windosill and with good reason. The game is the product of the same studio, Vectorpark, and it’s as distinctive as one of Lowry’s matchstick municipalities.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: The Hunter Is Nigh, Also Other Cool Stuff
notes.notes:
First of all, we sincerely apologize for being silent for so long. From now on I'll do what I can as a new Nekki's moderator on the Steam Community Forums. You can address me any questions you need to be answered.

Many developers in Nekki can't pay enough attention to Vector, because of intensive work on… Vector|LAB! We are proud to announce [b]the sequel[/b] to our beloved game! Our hero wakes up in the middle of experimental scientific complex and tries to find his way out. But what about other subjects? Why are there no personnel? What awaits him on his run? You will get all the answers as soon as we complete the game. Right now I want to give you [url=http://cloud-3.steampowered.com/ugc/3260917207439402803/2C62D7389A61EB16A3A72F5829921BE5CCCB92A5/]this pretty art[/url] . It's just a glimpse into the lab. More stuff coming soon!

Since winter we've been using all our resources not only to improve old ideas, but to create something brand new. We are planning to release all the downloadable content mentioned before and even more! [i]Hunter Mode[/i] is to be released before the end of July. After that we’re going to polish [i]Level Editor[/i]. It’ll be available with support for [i]Steam Workshop[/i] and [i]Steam Cloud[/i]! Keep in mind, all these cool features will be released as FREE updates.

notes.title: Complete control: Big Vector Steam update!
notes.notes:
The first batch of FREE additional content is finally ready to be delivered - alongside some modifications for the recent version:
- Xbox-controller support for Windows 7 and 8 - run, jump and slide with your favourite gaming device (Windows XP not supported)
- additional languages supported (Japanese, Chinese Simple, Chinese Traditional, Vietnam, Hebrew, Arabian, Thai, Polish, Czech, Hindi, Dutch, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, Swedish, Ukrainian, Greek, Latvian and Korean)
- several bug fixes applied
- Vector intro/outro now playing properly on start-up/finishing the game

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Vector, 30% off!
notes.notes:
Vector is Now Available on Steam and is 30% off!*
Vector is an exciting, arcade-style game featuring you as the exceptional free runner who won’t be held down by the system. The game opens with a view into a totalitarian world where freedom and individually is nothing more than a distant dream. But the heart of a freerunner is strong, and you soon break free. Run, vault, slide and climb using extraordinary techniques based on the urban ninja sport of Parkour all while being chased by “Big Brother” who’s sole purpose is to capture you and bring you back.

Inspired by the practice and principles of Parkour, Vector’s intuitive controls please players of all levels, and sophisticated level designs challenge the most demanding players with fast-paced timing puzzles as the traceur “flows” over the dystopian rooftops.

The best parkour-inspired action game! Vector lets you break free and run! Don’t get caught!
*Offer ends December 10 at 10AM Pacific Time
